title: RepoAssure AI IDE Repair Patch Plan MCP Tool Implementation v0.1
objective: Use TDD and the test pyramid to implement only the additive generate_repair_patch_plan MCP tool by reusing the package-owned repair patch-plan runner, accepting only a required reportPath and optional outputDir, and preserving bounded output, redaction, maintainer review, verification checklist, installed-consumer, and no-target-write boundaries from ADR-0024.
acceptance: Preserve all ten existing MCP tools unchanged and add only generate_repair_patch_plan.
Reuse the package-owned repair patch-plan runner without duplicating domain logic.
Require reportPath and support only optional outputDir.
Return only planPath, markdownPath, actionCount, autoFixCandidates, and status as bounded structured output.
Declare readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint false, and openWorldHint false.
Prove fail-closed errors, text and structured redaction, real tools/list and tools/call, installed consumer compatibility, maintainer review, verification checklist, and no target repository writes.
Keep evidence-package MCP, validation-only execution, arbitrary commands, resources, prompts, automatic patch application, publication, and deployment outside this Goal.
